title: EvidenceDescriptor
description: Identifies a piece of evidence by content address.

media_type.description: MIME type of the evidence blob, e.g. 'application/octet-stream'.

digest.description: Content-addressed SHA256 digest of the evidence blob.

size.description: Size of the evidence blob in bytes.

path_hint.description: Optional hint for locating the evidence file locally. Not authoritative.
